runs.name: Tori

lines.brief: Make me a steady dock beat. Two layers, four hits with Dock Echo. Keep it around one fifteen.
lines.success: Those echoes leave room for the dock. That's our pulse!
lines.slow: Give it a little more pace. The dock needs some lift.
lines.fast: Ease the pace a little. Leave room between those echoes.
lines.layers: Let's hear two clear layers. Bring another pad into the beat.
lines.fx: Try Dock Echo on a pad with four hits. Let that repeat carry the groove.
lines.save: Store your beat on the shelf, then save. Bring that version back to me.

lines.brief: Give the breakwater a bright little ident. Two layers, four hits with Signal Repeat. Aim around one thirty-five.
lines.success: Tight repeats and a clear pulse. That's a signal worth keeping!
lines.slow: Pick up the pace a little. Give that signal some spark.
lines.fast: Ease back on the tempo. Keep those repeats clear.
lines.layers: Add a second clear layer. Let the two parts answer each other.
lines.fx: Put Signal Repeat on a pad with four hits. I want that quick echo.
lines.save: Store your beat on the shelf and save. Bring me that version.
